text:
maria: Heads-up - automated artifact scanner found KMS-wrapped blobs in the partner-artifacts bucket that reference an older cryptoKey version. Not plaintext, but treat as potential exposure until we validate KEK bindings.
luke: path? example object name?
maria: gs://partner-artifacts/redwood/keystore-wrapped/ci-2026-03-19-*-wrap.bin, example ci-20260319-service-secrets.wrap. Metadata shows key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kek-main/cryptoKeys/keystore/cryptoKeyVersions/2
priya: v2? I thought we rolled keys last year to v5. How did v2 end up in partner artifacts?
tina: Partner CI uses an older action that still references the legacy wrap key. We asked them to upgrade but maybe not all workflows changed.
vaultbot: Note: Vault transit also had some secrets encrypted and then wrapped by KMS in that CI flow. Need to validate double-encrypt compatibility after rekey.
maria: Immediate ask: 1) revoke any principals that can use cryptoKeyVersion 2, 2) snapshot and copy the flagged objects to a quarantine bucket, 3) run audit query for decrypts against the key/version.
luke: I can do the quarantine copy first so we have frozen artifacts to work from.
priya: IAM cleanup: list bindings then remove stale accounts. Command to inspect policy:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy keystore --keyring=kek-main --location=global --project=redwood
```
Then remove partner CI service account entries.
tina: Rewrap approach idea: create a new key version (v6) set as primary, then rewrap ciphertexts with KMS.rewrap and replace objects atomically (write to quarantine then mv). We'll do a small-sample dry run on partner staging bucket first.
maria: Audit filter to run (Cloud Logging):
```
resource.type="kms_crypto_key"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"
protoPayload.resourceName:"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kek-main/cryptoKeys/keystore"
```
Search last 400d. If any unexpected principals show up, escalate.
sec-bot: Assignments: @luke -> copy flagged objects to gs://redwood-quarantine/partner/ (done as immutable copy), @priya -> prune KEK IAM bindings and open infra-iam PR, @tina -> prepare rewrap job + dry-run, @maria -> run audit sweep and post findings.
luke: Copied 12 flagged objects to quarantine with object-level lock metadata. Checksums captured.
priya: Drafted IAM PR to remove partner-ci@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. Pushed for review: infra/infra-iam#678.
tina: Dry-run rewrap on 5 samples in staging passed. Kept old metadata keys: original-version, rewrapped-by, sha256-old, sha256-new.
maria: Audit sweep: 3 decrypt events in last 180d from a runner account we rotated in Feb; no external IPs, no unknown principals. Flagged to eng-sre for runner artifact review.
priya: After IAM PR merges we'll disable v2 by setting it to DISABLED (not destroy) to allow safe fallback if needed.
sec-bot: Reminder: schedule 60m maintenance window for production rewrap and Vault transit rotation. Confirm rollback steps: restore from quarantine and point apps back to original object pointers.
luke: Quarantine copy integrity verified. SHA256 match with originals.
tina: Prod rewrap plan: 1) IAM prune, 2) create new key version v6 and make primary, 3) staged rewrap to quarantine, 4) swap pointer file, 5) rotate Vault transit key + restart vault pods if needed. We'll do canary on 50 files then bulk.
maria: Post-action monitoring: watch KMS Decrypt error spikes, Vault unwrap errors, and app auth failures for 60m after swap. I'll be on pager.
sec-bot: Assigned follow-ups: @priya mark PR urgent, @tina run canary, @luke hold rollback script ready, @maria finish audit doc.
priya: IAM PR merged, removed partner service account. v2 now has no IAM bindings.
tina: Canary rewrap succeeded on 50 files; checksums and metadata OK. Starting bulk now.
luke: Bulk rewrap complete, swapped pointer file to gs://partner-artifacts/redwood/keystore-latest -> 2026-03-19-rewrapped/, rolling config update to point apps.
maria: Apps smoke tests passed, Vault unwraps good. No decrypt anomalies in the immediate post window. Closing action: will file incident PRIV-2026-03-ARTIFACT-WRAP and attach PRs + checksums.
sec-bot: Closing assignments. Great coordination :thumbsup:
